tweets.text:
🚨HSTF Interdiction Success🚨

Homeland Security Task Force San Juan intercepted a vessel southeast of Puerto Rico, seizing 1,418 Ibs.(643.3 kg) of cocaine and detaining three Venezuelan nationals.

Last night, a @cbpamo (Caribbean Air and Marine Branch) aircraft detected a suspicious boat operating without lights, 35 nautical miles offshore. After coordinated efforts involving air and marine units, the vessel was stopped and searched, revealing bricks of cocaine concealed in black fuel containers.

This prosecution is part of the Homeland Security Task Force (@HSTFNCC) initiative, established by Executive Order 14159, Protecting the American People Against Invasion. HSTF is a whole-of-government partnership dedicated to eliminating criminal cartels, foreign gangs, transnational criminal organizations, and human smuggling and trafficking rings operating in the U.S. and abroad.

HSTF San Juan includes federal, state, and local partners working together to protect Puerto Rico and the USVI and secure our borders.

#BorderSecurity #Interdiction #HSTF
#HomelandSecurityTaskForce #DrugSeizure
